GOOD TO KNOW

A few things you
might be wondering.

Can you combine more than one function?+

Share the full sequence of events. We can discuss separate styling directions and how to connect them across the celebration.

What if my occasion is not listed?+

Tell us what you are planning. We can discuss whether the scope and location are suitable for our services.

Can I bring my own references?+

Yes. Share the colours, photographs or themes that appeal to you. References help us understand the feeling you want to create.

Do you offer fixed prices?+

Every setting is different. Your venue, scale, decoration and coordination requirements inform the personalised quote.
